findings.summary: Runtime cancel_control64 omits the supported T post-check cancellation followed by checked Store rollback of the same current operation.
findings.evidence: T.pin_many/5 receives genuine {:ok,pin}, then on expired deadline/dead holder calls cancel(owner,operation) at124 before returning pending. The design requires Store to cancel every started original ledger entry after this error. With k prior/current started batches the public T path sends one additional cancel plus k Store rollback controls, all potentially outstanding: k+1<=65. No arbitrary callback failure or fabricated receipt is involved.

Recommended minimum: retain existing public T behavior and pay65; cap4124 implies subtotal268060 instead of263936, delta4124 before other runtime-profile changes. Keep old worksheet64 and literal assertions as historical conditional arithmetic, explicitly never qualified for current runtime. Add deterministic genuine T post-check-failure plus checked Store rollback coverage; duplicate operation identity is idempotence, not proof the second message costs zero.
